AI is now a required skill in 12% of remote job listings we analyzed. Here's what that means for your career.

We looked at 3,928 listings on Loker Dollar and found 487 that explicitly require AI skills. That's 12% of the market. The highest disclosed pay range? Jabil's Sr. Principal Product Engineer at USD 132,400–238,400 per year, a role that lists AI-adjacent cloud expertise.

AI requirements appear across roles, from engineering to sales and people ops. But here's the contrarian take: AI isn't the most demanded skill. Communication leads at 41% of listings. And 78% of active listings hide salary, so don't assume AI equals a premium.

If you're an Indonesian remote worker, this is your signal to add AI skills to your toolkit. But don't neglect communication and domain expertise.

Want to see which remote roles list AI? Search "AI" on Loker Dollar.
